description: Book a real in-home appliance repair for your person in Middle Tennessee or South Louisiana: no forms, no phone tag for them. TN Appliance Exchange is family-owned since 2012, 4.5★ from 1,100+ Google reviews, 8,000+ repairs since 2022. The in-home visit is $100 plus tax and is credited toward the repair; home-warranty customers pay only their deductible. This creates a real job, and within minutes we text or call them (Ann, our AI receptionist) to set the day. Use check_service_area first. Only call after the person has agreed to book and to be texted or called about it. Never promise an appointment time, an arrival window, or any price other than those stated here. Side effects: creates one new job at our shop and starts a text or call to the phone given; it is not idempotent, so call it once per repair and do not retry a success. Returns booked: true with a job_id and what happens next; or booked: false with an error saying what to ask for (missing consent, phone, ZIP), or, for a ZIP we don't cover, the video Quick Check option instead. To reschedule or cancel an existing booking, the person replies to our text or calls/texts (629) 272-1234 (answered 24/7); our team makes changes on that thread, so there is no tool for that. For the $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check (anywhere in the US, credited toward the labor if they go ahead with the repair), use start_quick_check: it returns the link where the person starts and pays for it themselves.

address.description: Street address of the home with the appliance, if they gave it (Ann confirms it otherwise).

availability.description: Days that generally work for them, if they said. A preference only; we set the day by text or call.

city.description: City or town of that home.

customer_confirmed.description: true only if the person explicitly agreed to book this repair. Anything else returns an error and books nothing.

first_name.description: The person's first name (what Ann will call them).

last_name.description: Last name, if they gave it.

model_number.description: Model number from the sticker, if known; helps the technician bring the right part.

phone.description: 10-digit US mobile number that can receive texts; any formatting is fine.

problem.description: What is wrong, in the person's words (symptoms, error codes, how long).
examples: Fridge is warm, freezer still cold, started yesterday

sms_consent.description: true only if the person agreed to be texted or called about the repair. Anything else returns an error and books nothing.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP of that home; must be a covered ZIP (check_service_area).

name: book_repair

booked.description: true when a job was created

covered.description: Present when the ZIP is not covered (booked is false)

error.description: Present only when the call could not be completed; says what to fix or who to call.

message.description: A plain-English answer you can pass to the person as is.

what_happens_next.description: What the person should expect (we text or call to set the day)

title: Book an in-home appliance repair
